page.overview:
What is Sunanokegawa?

Sandy Shocks is an ancient Paradox Pokémon that resembles the artificial Pokémon Magneton with contrasting prehistoric looks. It is a silvery-blue metallic creature made up of three magnetized electric orbs, with screws attached to each. Electromagnetism appears to hold this Pokémon together. Each orb seems to function as a head, with a round yellow eye and black pupils on each; the main top orb (that resembles a single Magnemite) has purplish markings above the eye, and four black dots below it, vaguely resembling a face. Sandy Shocks possesses four magnet-like formations (with red and blue, positive and negative, markings at the ends) that act as limbs (arms and legs) attached to its body. Two short magnets are attached to the top head (acting as arms), and two long, flexible manget-limbs attached to each of its bottom heads, which it uses as legs to crawl and walk. The tips of each magnet on this Pokémon are coated in tufts of iron filings. The top of its main "head" is tipped with a large bolt frilled with iron particles. Sandy Shocks has a long tail made of attached bolts, and tipped with an iron filling tuft.

It is said to resemble a Magneton that has lived for 10,000 years. There have been many sightings of Sandy Shocks, where no one apparently has been able to capture it. Sandy Shocks is known to be very aggressive, attacking anyone who has seen it. It takes its name from a matching description in Scarlet Book.

Sandy Shocks can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it is holding a Booster Energy. It uses its long flexible magnet-like legs to crawl and propel itself swiftly across the ground. Its magnet-limbs appear to naturally attract iron fillings.

Sandy Shocks is inspired by Magneton, resembling a prehistoric form of it. Its inspiration might be based on natural electromagnetism within the earth and certain natural metal elements that are magnetic (as Magneton, its present-day counterpart, is an artificial robotic Pokémon).
